CandidatePublicationBinding.description:
Trusted proof that the candidate was published from the evaluated source.

A PR observation is not sufficient provenance: the provider could be showing a
different head than the controller evaluated.  This record is produced by the
controller's trusted publication path and is independently verified before any
provider mutation is allowed.
CandidatePublicationBinding.title: CandidatePublicationBinding

GitRefSnapshot.description: The trusted Git state against which a dry-run was evaluated.
GitRefSnapshot.title: GitRefSnapshot

IntegrationCampaignEvidencePackage.description: Immutable, replayable evidence for one sanitized live campaign.
IntegrationCampaignEvidencePackage.title: IntegrationCampaignEvidencePackage

IntegrationMergeResult.description: Provider merge response; ambiguous responses cannot be treated as success.
IntegrationMergeResult.title: IntegrationMergeResult

IntegrationPromotionIntent.description: Durable intent written immediately before the provider merge call.
IntegrationPromotionIntent.title: IntegrationPromotionIntent

IntegrationPromotionReceipt.description: Immutable provider observation; soak is intentionally not represented here.
IntegrationPromotionReceipt.title: IntegrationPromotionReceipt

IntegrationProviderObservation.description: Provider-side PR observation used before requesting a merge.
IntegrationProviderObservation.title: IntegrationProviderObservation

IntegrationProviderReconciliation.description: The single bounded observation used to resolve an ambiguous PR request.
IntegrationProviderReconciliation.title: IntegrationProviderReconciliation

IntegrationRollbackRequest.description: Exact topology and identities for one case-7 rollback attempt.
IntegrationRollbackRequest.title: IntegrationRollbackRequest

PromotionLeaseEvidence.description:
Immutable evidence for the controller lease that fenced a campaign.

``digest`` is the digest of the lease payload (the same digest exposed by
:class:`PromotionLease`).  The surrounding ``ArtifactRef`` addresses this
complete record, so timestamps and identity remain auditable after the
ephemeral lease file is released.
PromotionLeaseEvidence.title: PromotionLeaseEvidence

PromotionMutationAuthorization.description: Durable authorization crossing the provider mutation boundary.
PromotionMutationAuthorization.title: PromotionMutationAuthorization

RollbackPromotionBundleAuthorization.description:
Controller-issued authority for one protected integration rollback.

This record is deliberately separate from ordinary promotion attestations.
It is created only after the controller has checked the durable canary,
drill authorization, candidate publication, and the current repository
topology.  The ID is a content address of every field except itself.
RollbackPromotionBundleAuthorization.title: RollbackPromotionBundleAuthorization

description:
Core durable join between a canary and its protected rollback.

This is the semantic core, not the complete hosted-live completion package.
JSON Schema describes wire shape only; callers must use Pydantic validation
because the cross-record topology, authorization, and content-addressing
invariants below are not delegated to JSON Schema.
title: LiveRollbackEvidencePackage
